targetSelector.description: Workloads to which the code-server addon is attached. Defaults to `main`.

env.description: Environment variables of the code-server container.

enabled.description: Enable the object of the add-on.

anyOf.description: Named Service objects of the code-server addon, next to `enabled`.

service.description: Service of the code-server addon. Either one Service object, or named Service objects next to `enabled`.

enabled.description: Enable the object of the add-on.

anyOf.description: Named Ingress objects of the code-server addon, next to `enabled`.

ingress.description: Ingress of the code-server addon. Either one Ingress object, or named Ingress objects next to `enabled`.

route.description: Gateway API route of the code-server addon, the same as a `route.<name>` of the chart. It defaults to the `codeserver` service and port, and is the primary route when no other route is primary. Select the gateway with `gateway`, `parentRefs` or `listenerSet`.
